QuestInfo.name: [Magatia] Making the Reagent
QuestInfo.0: To help Yulete out, I volunteered to assist him on his research. What can I do for him? I better go see #bYulete#k.
QuestInfo.1: Yulete asked me to help him #bmake the Reagent#k. I'll need to pour the prepared liquid in the beaker and make the reagent, but I heard that the liquids have to be poured in sequence. .. And the sequence is #bred, green, yellow, blue, and purple#k! Let's make this. \n\n#i4031798##t4031798# #b#c4031798##k/1
QuestInfo.2: After successfully making the reagent, I reported the results to Yulete. He thanked me for helping him with something that he considered was a difficult task.

0.0: What I want you to do is help me make a reagent. Making a reagent requires precise calculations, but I've already done that for you, so all I need from you is to take care of this in a speedy manner. Can you do this?

yes.0: Go to the left, and you'll see one three doors that leads to the lab. Enter the #bfirst door#k, and you'll see a beaker inside. Your job is the pour the liquid I gave you inside to make the #bcompleted reagent#k. Be care, though, you can't just put in the ingredients and expect to make a reagent.
yes.1: The ingredients for the reagent that I gave you must be placed in the order of #bred, green, yellow, blue, and purple.#k. If the order's incorrect, you'll have to make the reagent all over again, so please don't forget the order! That's Red, green, yellow, blue, and purple!
yes.2: As long as you watch out for the order, making the reagent shouldn't be hard. Good luck!

no.0: There must be something that's holding you back. If you have time down the road, please come see me.

1.0: Great work making the reagent. I know it must have been not easy to complete the task. Great work there. Thanks to your work, the reagent for the next experiment should be ready right away.

item.0: I don't think you've gotten me a finished reagent yet.
